demos.proves: the current canonical entry, semantic coverage, durable identity, runtime registration, Artifact, Workspace, Report, and Recipe contracts are reproducible
demos.reportRecipeExpectation: explicit UI Preview and Finalize over persisted facts; paired non-executable Recipe
